acceptance_tests: A packaged Unreal Engine 5.6 build is produced and repeatedly launched on one declared target machine.
Voice activity causes an applied listening pose, confirmed only after the Anim Blueprint or Control Rig applies it, and VAD-to-listening p95 meets the predeclared RT-02 threshold.
Real Korean microphone input is evaluated for at least the RT-11-required sample count, stated in the material as 20 or more, and meets the predeclared latency and CER thresholds.
Cognition produces interruptible speech through the selected TTS provider without blocking required Reflex or Behavior cadence defined by the contract.
Exact phoneme timing drives applied MetaHuman curves, and audio-to-applied-viseme p95 meets the predeclared RT-08 threshold; heuristic-only and cursor-only samples do not count as passing evidence.

Barge-in stops audible playback on the real output device, cancels the active generation, resets mouth and presentation state, and returns the character to the contractually defined valid conversational state within the RT-05 threshold.
Late cognition, STT, TTS, HTTP, PCM, engine, and reordered provider callbacks from cancelled generations are rejected and never replace or revive the active presentation.
Cancellation and deliberately reordered provider-response trials record zero stale-callback resurrection events across all contracted repetitions.

UE Automation results, audiovisual recordings, latency traces, percentile calculations, generation and runtime-epoch logs, provider ordering logs, build identity, machine identity, and device identity are captured for the same tested revision.

The minimal loop completes without requiring Looking Glass hardware, broad World or NavMesh behavior, identity-candidate promotion, production deployment work, arm64 publishing, or multi-machine portability.

plan.first_authorized_action: Prepare, without beginning integration, the revision-pinned one-page slice contract for repository revision 15e390d0b7ab4fff00903baea7efdc6f396b3e1a and the companion dependency-inventory template covering UE 5.6, MetaHuman assets, target machine, microphone, audio output, Korean STT, cognition, TTS, owners, acquisition paths, thresholds, repetitions, artifacts, and stop conditions.
plan.plan_summary: Make the packaged Unreal 5.6 realtime vertical slice the next cross-project milestone, gated first by a revision-pinned slice contract and dependency inventory. Proceed to integration only when every essential prerequisite is confirmed or has a bounded owner and acquisition path. Explicitly defer production migration clearance and character-identity candidate promotion.
risk_controls: Stop before integration if any essential prerequisite is missing and lacks a named owner, concrete acquisition path, and deadline.
Pin the contract, build, evidence, and conclusions to repository revision 15e390d0b7ab4fff00903baea7efdc6f396b3e1a.
Declare numeric thresholds and sampling rules before implementation or measurement to prevent post hoc acceptance.
Count only applied pose and applied viseme confirmations; do not substitute state observation, heuristic timing, or cursor movement.
Instrument generation IDs, runtime epochs, cancellation timestamps, callback origins, and provider response ordering end to end.
Exercise late and reordered callbacks intentionally, including after barge-in and cancellation.
Reject demo-specific architectural shortcuts that bypass existing cancellation, transport, Game Thread, persistence, or callback boundaries.
Keep Looking Glass, broad World and NavMesh validation, full RT-01–RT-13 coverage, arm64 publishing, multi-machine portability, and production deployment outside the slice.
Do not claim production migration readiness without authorized live flyway_schema_history evidence, the disposable PostgreSQL gate, and representative-scale lock measurements.
Do not promote v10 or v11 as an identity candidate without authorized canonical references, populated review evidence, declared identity thresholds, and named human approval.
Report failed or incomplete evidence as a stopped or inconclusive milestone rather than expanding scope automatically.

sequence.entry_gate: Use only the supplied repository evidence and selected packaged-Unreal milestone.
sequence.exit_gate: The contract pins the revision and states the exact scenario, repetitions, numeric thresholds, artifacts, exclusions, and stop conditions without unresolved acceptance semantics.

Every essential dependency is confirmed or has a named owner, concrete acquisition path, and deadline; the project can produce and repeatedly run a packaged build on the declared target; the loop requires no substantial excluded work. Otherwise stop the milestone.

sequence.entry_gate: WS2 issues a go recommendation with no unbounded essential dependency.
sequence.exit_gate: A packaged build completes one instrumented loop, applies listening pose and visemes, accepts barge-in, returns to a valid state, and exposes callback-generation evidence.

sequence.entry_gate: The instrumented packaged build and all contracted evidence capture paths are operational.
sequence.exit_gate: All contracted repetitions complete with required artifacts; RT-02, RT-04, RT-05, RT-08, and RT-11 thresholds pass; barge-in recovery succeeds; and stale-callback resurrection count is zero. Any threshold miss yields a failed or inconclusive gate, not a success claim.

sequence.entry_gate: WS4 has a complete evidence report.
sequence.exit_gate: The result is scoped to the tested slice, and production migration clearance and identity-candidate promotion remain explicitly deferred.
